__comment: Uses item/handheld (flat sprite) so the custom texture is
visible in the inventory and hand without needing a full 3D
trident element array.  The base material is TRIDENT which
gives the throwing mechanic and riptide/loyalty enchants.
If you want a fully 3D trident, replace with an elements array
in Blockbench.  The item/trident parent is internal to Minecraft
and does not support external texture replacement cleanly.
